scripts.package:linux: pnpm prepackage && if [ -n "${RDST_BUILD_VERSION:-}" ]; then electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never -c.extraMetadata.version="$RDST_BUILD_VERSION" -c.extraMetadata.rdstUpdates="${RDST_DESKTOP_UPDATES:-disabled}"; else electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never; fi
scripts.package:mac: pnpm prepackage && if [ -n "${RDST_BUILD_VERSION:-}" ]; then electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.extraMetadata.version="$RDST_BUILD_VERSION" -c.extraMetadata.rdstUpdates="${RDST_DESKTOP_UPDATES:-disabled}"; else electron-builder --mac --publish never; fi
scripts.prepackage: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm build
